spells.name: Fireball
spells.description: Launch a fireball that explodes on impact and leaves the ground burning.

spells.name: Firebeam
spells.description: Unleash a giant fire beam that scorches everything.

spells.name: Surcharge
spells.description: Burn all enemies in a wide zone, detonating those already ablaze.

spells.name: Wisp
spells.description: Summon a wisp that deals extra burn damage, jumping to another enemy on kill.

spells.name: Finger Guns
spells.description: Swap your weapon for fiery fingers that shoot explosive fire bullets.

spells.name: Strikes
spells.description: Launch a line of lightning strikes that zap everything in their path.

spells.name: Boing
spells.description: Instantly jump to escape your enemies.

spells.name: Portal
spells.description: Spawn up to two portals that teleport players and duplicate spell projectiles.

spells.name: Swap
spells.description: Swap positions with an enemy, exploding at both locations.

spells.name: Thunderstrike
spells.description: Rise up, then dive down to blast the area and unleash thunder over your enemies.

spells.name: Thrower
spells.description: Spit jets of acid that leave corrosive puddles on the ground.

spells.name: Geyser
spells.description: Summon an acid geyser that erupts on impact.

spells.name: Bubble
spells.description: Throw a big acid bubble that bursts on impact and creates multiple acid puddles.

spells.name: Contagion
spells.description: Corrodes all enemies in a wide zone and applies Contagious, causing them to explode on death.

spells.name: Rain
spells.description: Call down a rain of acid that corrodes enemies in a wide area.

spells.name: Drain
spells.description: Command your doll to drain an enemy's health.

spells.name: Rescue
spells.description: Channel your doll's power to heal or revive the nearest ally.

spells.name: Corruption
spells.description: Channel a doll to corrupt enemies, making them fight for you.

spells.name: Ritual
spells.description: Summon a ring of candles that restores the health of allies within its light.

spells.name: Doll
spells.description: Summon a doll that grants invincibility and high speed to allies within its zone.

spells.name: Mino
spells.description: Summon a cactus mine that explodes when stepped on.

spells.name: Pistolero
spells.description: Summon a cactus turret that fires continuously at nearby enemies.

spells.name: Wallo
spells.description: Summon cactus spikes that damage and slow enemies on contact.

spells.name: Decoyo
spells.description: Summon a dancing cactus that lures enemies before exploding.

spells.name: Bandito
spells.description: Summon a powerful cactus golem that fights for you for a while.

spells.name: Breeze
spells.description: Summon a breeze that freezes enemies in a wide cone.

spells.name: Bridge
spells.description: Summon a bridge that shields allies who cross it.

spells.name: Cube
spells.description: Turn yourself or an ally into an invulnerable ice cube.

spells.name: Glaze
spells.description: Release a burst, dealing damage to nearby enemies and shielding nearby allies.

spells.name: Blizzard
spells.description: Summon a blizzard that follows you, dealing damage to all enemies and shielding allies.
